blocks.content: The Lokpal shall consist of a Chairperson and eight members, out of which fifty per cent shall be Judicial Members.

items: Maharashtra was the first state to establish the institution of Lokayukta in 1971, although Odisha passed the act first in 1970.
The Prime Minister is covered under Lokpal jurisdiction, except on matters of international relations, security, public order, atomic energy, and space.
Lokpal has powers equivalent to a civil court while trying cases and can sanction prosecution for public servants.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The institution of Ombudsman was first created in Sweden in 1809 to guard citizens against administrative abuse.
In India, the Administrative Reforms Commission (1966-1970) recommended setting up Lokpal at the Centre and Lokayuktas in states.
The Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act was passed in 2013 and came into force on January 16, 2014.
Selection committee for Lokpal consists of the PM, Speaker of Lok Sabha, Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, CJI or nominee, and an eminent jurist.
Fifty percent of Lokpal members must belong to SC, ST, OBC, Minorities, and Women.
